EC1: - 1-patient refusal. 2-psychiatric disorders. 3-pregnancy [AND] and lactation. 4-preexisting neurological dysfunction (history of cerebrovascular stroke CVS) 5-metastatic cancer.
EC2: 6-Inflammatory bowel disease. 7-Diabetes mellitus. 8-Renal insufficiency (serum creatinine level more than 180 μmol/l). 9- unexpected intraoperative findings (inoperable). 10-accidental massive intraoperative hemorrhage.
